study: qal/mesh -- RESONANT MESH CLOCKING, whole-design, phase/antiphase. PURE SPEED.
written_before_any_deck: This file is the ONLY file in qal/mesh/ at its mtime. Every deck, harness line and acceptance below is fixed BEFORE the first simulation.

ASSUMED_by_user_license.mesh_in_place: Resonant clock meshes are established art (rotary travelling-wave, standing-wave, resonant H-tree). The user licenses the assumption: the mesh EXISTS, two phases in exact antiphase, zero mesh jitter, and this run does not design it. Each phase is modeled as a DRIVEN RAIL WAVEFORM (ideal source behind a uniform small series R; ONE stiffness sensitivity bounds the idealisation, labeled SENSITIVITY).
ASSUMED_by_user_license.mesh_interface_spec: The charge the mesh must source/sink per bank per phase is REPORTED (fC, plus fJ alongside) as the spec handed to the mesh designer. Mesh Q, drive loss, wiring: the mesh designer's problem BY ASSUMPTION. Nothing is gated on energy.
ASSUMED_by_user_license.mesh_to_mesh_parasitic_coupling: ASSUMED handled by the mesh; the coupling measured here is the through-DEVICE / data-path coupling of a phase edge into antiphase banks' logic nodes, which no mesh design can remove.

COSTS_DELETED_vs_campaign.transfer_switch: GONE (was the 6.6 fJ owner and the 24x gate-charge problem). Cells hang DIRECTLY off the mesh phase: supply AND pMOS bulk on the phase node.
COSTS_DELETED_vs_campaign.timer: GONE (23.213 fJ ledger, 7.272 ps budget term, calibration, tracking-ratio failure). The antiphase IS the schedule.
COSTS_DELETED_vs_campaign.return_ZCS_schedule: GONE (the antiphase IS the return; the mesh reabsorbs the bank charge).
COSTS_DELETED_vs_campaign.budget_remaining_with_timer_gone: Deterministic budget that SURVIVES: (a) voltage domain: 3*sigma_total = 69.924 mV at the commit sample (sigma_total 23.308 mV MEASURED qal/eye/p2 U3: 6.441 mV trip + 22.4 mV driver, rss); (b) time domain: mesh jitter = 0 ASSUMED (licensed), so no ps term remains -- the handoff overlap is reported raw and must be > 0; (c) instrument: the +1.0 ps Xyce .measure-FIND lag convention (bt.py LAG_PS, MEASURED).

architecture.phasing: odd banks (1,3,5) on phase A, even (2,4,6) on antiphase B. A-bank outputs wire DIRECTLY to B-bank inputs. No flop, latch, buffer, keeper, level shifter anywhere.
architecture.cell_netlist: Campaign-standard RESTORING inverter VERBATIM from qal/banktank/bt.py bank_cells(): pMOS sg13_lv_pmos w=1.12u l=0.13u with source AND bulk on the bank's phase node; nMOS sg13_lv_nmos w=0.74u l=0.13u source+bulk on the bank's metered ground (VMG{k} 0V source); CL 2 fF per cell output. Inverter-class chosen (the committed cell); nand2-class would change the pattern algebra and is out of scope -- stated per the task's 'state the netlist'.
architecture.depth: d = 1/2/3/4 series inverter levels per bank, 8 parallel chains (MGATE=8, the campaign bank word). All d levels inside a bank hang on the SAME phase node.
architecture.head: Bank 1's inputs are ideal full-swing PWL word sources (chain-head convention, banktank verbatim), transitioning with 2 ps edges at phase-A troughs (t = n*T). The WORD ALTERNATES every period: wave n = PAT for n even, complement(PAT) for n odd -- every gate sees both polarities and every wave is a real transition.
architecture.spatial_pattern_confirm: P2-alt run (all-ones alternating with all-zeros -- both extreme words in one run) at each per-(waveform,T_half) frontier point. Eye/value intersection is over {waves 2,3,4} x {P0-alt run, P2-alt run}.

waveforms.sine: V_A(t) = (dV/2)*(1 - cos(2*pi*t/T)), dV = 1.65 V, T = 2*T_half. V_B = dV - V_A. Xyce SIN sources; smoke test digit-checks V_A(0)~0, V_A(T/2)=1.65, V_B(0)=1.65.
waveforms.sawtooth: Voltage PWL per phase: linear ramp 0 -> dV over (1-f)*T, linear flyback dV -> 0 over f*T; antiphase = shifted T/2. Flyback fraction f swept {0.10, 0.20, 0.30}.
waveforms.sawtooth_modeling_choice_DECLARED: The SWEEP models the sawtooth as a VOLTAGE waveform (the user's 'model each phase as a driven rail waveform' license). WHY: it makes the flyback dV/dt a controlled aggressor for the coupling sweep, and it assumes the current-driven mesh scales I with bank load (stiff mesh) -- an assumption the stiffness sensitivity then bounds. The LOAD-DEPENDENT ramp of a true fixed-I drive is measured in a dedicated side experiment SAW-I: ONE bank, ideal current source I fixed at the value calibrated so the d=1 bank reaches dV exactly at ramp end (T_half=92, f=0.20), then d=2/3/4 run at the SAME I; the measured ramp-rate deficit vs d is the correction the mesh designer must budget (either I scales per bank by that factor, or the active fraction stretches by it). Reported, not gated.
waveforms.timeline: slot_start(bank k, wave n) = n*T + (k-1)*T_half for both waveforms; crest offset = T_half (sine) or (1-f)*T (saw). Bank k processes wave n in its slot; at any instant banks hold a marching wave sequence. tran end = 8.25*T; waves 0,1 are warmup; waves 2,3,4 are the >=3 steady-state periods scored.

t_reg_ps.label: DERIVED
t_reg_ps.source: interpolated from MEASURED 307.1/335.7 (qal/fcrit_skept SKSCORE family, 2 fF) per the task spec

sweep_grid.core: waveform {sine, saw f=0.20} x T_half {70,80,92,105,117,130} x d {1,2,3,4}, P0-alt word, d ascended per lane with early stop when the VALUE check fails (deeper is strictly harder at fixed T_half).
sweep_grid.flyback: f {0.10, 0.30} x d {1..4} at T_half = 92 (the 2x point), P0-alt.
sweep_grid.pattern_confirm: P2-alt at each (waveform, T_half) frontier d.
sweep_grid.stiffness: series R_s in {1, 3, 10, 30, 100} ohm per bank between ideal source and rail at the BEST accepted point (highest throughput ratio); for sine each R_s is also quoted as the DERIVED equivalent Q = 1/(2*pi*f*C_bank_meas*R_s) with C_bank_meas = Q_rise/dV from this study's own charge metering. SENSITIVITY, labeled; the main sweep runs R_s = 0.001 ohm (topology-preserving).
sweep_grid.concurrency: <= 4 Xyce concurrent (9 rfast jobs live on the box at pre-registration time; 16 cores); every .prn extracted then DELETED (root disk at 99%); one gzipped exemplar .prn kept at the headline point.

scoring_definitions.trip: Trip_S: linear interpolation on the 27 MEASURED points of qal/fcrit/TRIP.json cell S at the receiver's INSTANTANEOUS rail (trip fraction 0.7281 at 0.20 V ... 0.5179 at 1.50 V -- NOT a constant). DEVIATION from the tank-campaign EYE1 rule, pre-registered here: the mesh rail's domain [0,1.65] exceeds the table crest 1.50 V BY DESIGN, so above 1.50 V the trip uses the Trip class's built-in ratio extension (0.7768*V_rail/1.50) LABELED EXTRAPOLATED, and the fraction of each eye that used extrapolated trip is reported. Below 0.20 V the eye is simply CLOSED (in-table-from-below required). The binding edges sit at low rail, inside the measured table.
scoring_definitions.margin: mgn(link k, gate i, t) = +/-1000*(V(o_k_level-d_i) - Trip_S(V(rail_{k+1})(t))) mV, sign by the wave-n expected bit; expected bit at bank k level j, wave n, gate i = PAT[i] XOR (n&1) XOR (((k-1)*d+j)&1).
scoring_definitions.eye: per link k, wave n: contiguous runs of min-over-8-gates margin > threshold within the receiver's window, receiver rail >= 0.20 V required. Link 6's receiver rail is the DERIVED ideal A-phase waveform (labeled DERIVED). Eye edges by linear interpolation on the 0.10 ps common grid (qal/eye AMENDMENT E1 rule). Reported at thresholds 0 mV and 69.924 mV, polarities HIGH / LOW / all.
scoring_definitions.commit: t_commit(bank b, wave n) = opening edge of the eye of LINK b (bank b's outputs vs its receiver's instantaneous trip) whose run contains bank b's crest instant; NO-COMMIT if no run contains the crest.
scoring_definitions.die: t_die(bank k, wave n) = closing edge of that same link-k eye run (when the falling outputs stop being good at the receiver's trip).
scoring_definitions.handoff_overlap: overlap(link k) = t_die(k) - t_commit(k+1), defined for links 1..5 (bank 7 does not exist). THE quantity that carries the whole scheme; reported per waveform per config.
scoring_definitions.commit_sample_margin: margin_at_commit(link k) = min-gate margin of link k evaluated AT t_commit(k+1), links 1..5, per wave, per polarity.
scoring_definitions.value_check: per-gate, EVERY level of EVERY bank, at the bank's crest instant, waves 2,3,4 (steady state, >= 3 full periods): HIGH iff V >= 0.50*V(rail at crest), LOW iff V <= 0.10*V(rail at crest) (the committed rf.py criterion). Xyce .measure FIND with the +1.0 ps lag convention.
scoring_definitions.coupling: SAW: victim = antiphase banks' expected-LOW last-level outputs; bump = max V(victim) inside the aggressor flyback window minus max V(victim) over the same slot excluding the window +/-5 ps; plus the HIGH-margin dip coincident with the edge. SINE: same metric in a window centered on the antiphase's max |dV/dt| instants (phase-feedthrough). Reported in mV vs flyback fraction and vs the sine baseline. Prior art anchor: +113.6 mV at a logic node from a 227 V/ns edge (campaign measured).
scoring_definitions.crowbar_check: measured, not assumed: I(VMG{k}) and I(VPH{k}) of interior banks 3 (A) and 4 (B) in windows around their rail TROUGHS while their inputs are driven by the antiphase crest: peak and mean over trough +/-2 ps and over the rail<10%-of-dV window, plus the net charge from the per-bank 1F integrators. Sustained conduction = crowbar; displacement-only = clear.
scoring_definitions.no_settling_vocabulary: tracking lag / eye / margin at the sampling instant throughout.
scoring_definitions.no_reprobe: all commits, windows, coupling, crowbar extracted from ONE dense transient per configuration (0.10 ps print grid).

acceptance.A_value: ALL d*8 gates of ALL 6 banks value-correct at every crest of waves 2,3,4 (both runs where a P2-alt confirm exists).
acceptance.B_eye: links 1..5: margin_at_commit >= 69.924 mV (3*sigma_total, the budget that remains with the timer gone) for EVERY wave 2..4, BOTH polarities scored (LOW side explicitly verified, not assumed vacuous -- the tank-chain vacuous-LOW finding must be re-established or refuted on the full-swing rail).
acceptance.C_handoff: overlap(link k) > 0 for links 1..5, every wave 2..4.
acceptance.frontier: max d meeting A+B+C at each (waveform, T_half). If d=1 is all that fits at T_half=92, the throughput ratio is still 2.0x and that is a result; if even d=1 fails everywhere, the breaking MECHANISM is the deliverable.

throughput_metric.headline: ratio(d, T_half) = (d / T_period) / (1 / t_CMOS) = d * 367.888 / (2*T_half) -- throughput per LEVEL per STAGE: a bank commits d levels once per mesh period; the CMOS pipeline commits 1 level per stage per 367.888 ps. This reproduces the task's own example: d=2 at T_half=92 -> 4.0x. Corner ratio uses 467.888 ps.
throughput_metric.alternate_reported: chain-advance convention: a wave traverses d levels per T_half -> d*367.888/T_half (exactly 2x the headline); reported alongside, never as the headline.
throughput_metric.latency: latency per level = T_half/d, reported alongside vs CMOS 367.888 ps per level. NO latency claim (the standing rule stands).

PRE_STATED_EXPECTATIONS.sine_frontier: d=1 at T_half=70-80; d=2 at 92-105; d=3 at 117-130. Headline at the 2x point: 4.0x (d=2 @ 92). Mechanism limiting: the 1-cos flat spot (~15% of the half-period dead for cell drive) plus d compounding of the rising-side tracking lag.
PRE_STATED_EXPECTATIONS.saw_frontier: saw f=0.20 fits >= sine's d at every T_half (earlier useful voltage at the LOW-rail end where commits bind, AND the ramp occupies (1-f)*T = 1.6x the sine's T/2 rise); expected d=3 @ 92 -> 6.0x.
PRE_STATED_EXPECTATIONS.sawtooth_beats_sine: EXPECTED YES at f=0.20-0.30 for T_half >= 92; EXPECTED taken back at f=0.10 and short T_half by flyback coupling: predicted bump, linear in edge rate from the campaign's 113.6 mV @ 227 V/ns: f=0.20, T_half=92 -> edge 1.65V/36.8ps = 44.8 V/ns -> ~22 mV (below the 69.9 mV gate, NOT binding); f=0.10, T_half=70 -> 117.9 V/ns -> ~59 mV (approaching binding). Second take-back channel: the saw's structural input-valid overlap ~ (0.5-f)*T shrinks as f grows -- f=0.30 may lose the handoff at T_half <= 80.
PRE_STATED_EXPECTATIONS.handoff: sine overlap expected LARGER (the measured 60-90 ps drain-side tracking lag is an ABSOLUTE time, comparable to the whole half-period at T_half <= 92, so A's outputs barely fall before B commits); saw overlap expected structural (0.5-f)*T + drain lag - commit delay.
PRE_STATED_EXPECTATIONS.crowbar: expected NO sustained trough crowbar for restoring banks (input HIGH onto an inverter whose rail is at trough: nMOS pulls low, pMOS Vgs positive = off, no DC path) -- but the pMOS drain-well junction of a still-charged output CAN conduct into the falling rail (that is the drain-side tracking mechanism, not a crowbar). CHECKED not assumed.
PRE_STATED_EXPECTATIONS.LOW_side: expected NON-vacuous on the full-swing mesh rail: as a bank's HIGH inputs die with the antiphase fall, its expected-LOW outputs lift -- the LOW margin should be the one that closes the eye on the die side. Verify.
PRE_STATED_EXPECTATIONS.level_restoration: rail crest 1.65 V > 0.9642 V (the Vtn=0.5240 V cascade requirement), so the chain is level-restoring by construction at crest -- VERIFIED at T_half=70 where crest time is shortest.
PRE_STATED_EXPECTATIONS.stiffness: expect acceptance intact through R_s ~ 10-30 ohm (sag ~ I_pk*R_s, I_pk ~ 0.5-1 mA -> 20-30 mV at 30 ohm), collapse by 100 ohm. Sine equivalent-Q quoted per R_s.
PRE_STATED_EXPECTATIONS.charge_spec: Q_rise per bank per phase expected ~ d-scaled tens of fC (8 cells/level: 2 fF CL on switching HIGH outputs + junction/gate load at 1.65 V).
PRE_STATED_EXPECTATIONS.SAW_I: ramp-rate deficit vs d expected sublinear in d (only the HIGH-output CLs and junctions load the rail, and deeper levels' outputs lag), quantified as the I-scaling factor the mesh must budget.

sim_discipline.models: sg13_lv via qal/sg13lv_compat.sp; PSP103 via .hdl /usr/local/share/xyce/verilog-a/psp103/psp103.va + sg13g2_psp103_tt.lib (bt.py head_lines VERBATIM, .OPTIONS TIMEINT METHOD=GEAR RELTOL=1e-6 ABSTOL=1e-15 CHGTOL=1e-17)
sim_discipline.metering: t0-referenced 1F integrators ONLY (bt.py integ() verbatim: 1F cap + B-source current + 0.01 ohm bleed); per bank: q_phase = -I(VPH_k), e_phase = -V(rail_k)*I(VPH_k), q_gnd = I(VMG_k)
sim_discipline.steps: .tran 0.1p tend 0 0.25p (banktank committed steps); print grid 0.10 ps
sim_discipline.anchors: IC-A: the committed banktank row c_m10_T200_H4_dv1200_free.cir regenerated byte-identical and digit-checked against the committed .mt0 (rf.py cmd_ic1 protocol, own cache). IC-B: single-bank mesh smoke at the LARGEST half-period (130 ps, sine, d=1): waveform digit-check (V_A(0), V_A(T/2), V_B(0)), integrator sign vs C*dV, extractor trip values hand-checked (trip(1.65) = 0.85446 V EXTRAPOLATED flag true, trip(1.20) = 0.64516 in-table).
